description: This file defines the 'Setting' class within the Opencart admin event namespace. It extends a core Controller class and includes a method 'index' that updates scheduling tasks related to language, currency, and location settings whenever a specific route is called. The method checks the route, then uses models to add tasks based on configuration values, specifically auto currency updates.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class handling event-related updates to system settings, specifically scheduling tasks for language, currency, and location updates based on certain route conditions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that reacts to specific routing events; it adds tasks for language, currency, and location updates if the route does not match 'setting/setting.editSetting'. It checks configuration settings before adding certain tasks.
